title: ICMP: Fix conversation lines for error packets
description:
ICMP: Fix conversation lines for error packets

At the packet list pane, the conversation line between a data
packet and its related ICMP error response (timeout, no route,)
is not behaving ideally.

Add a conversation table to track the Transport Layer
conversations related to ICMP error packets.
Update the following protocols to handle this feature: UDP, TCP.

Both deinterlacing strategies (historical behavior with no
deinterlacing at all, and any deinterlacing key) are implemented
accordingly.

Fix #18636
